samples.question: The gray REFERENCE path and the three colored-border paths may be rotated as wholes, and their straight segment lengths may differ. Starting at the yellow dot and traveling to the cyan dot, compare only the ordered sequence of left and right turns at the black bend dots. A mirror reflection does not count. Which candidate border color has exactly the same turn sequence: red, green, or blue?
